+
+def test_release_returns_reserved_stock_to_available():
+    inv = Inventory()
+    inv.receive("A", 10)
+    inv.reserve("A", 6)
+
+    inv.release("A", 4)
+
+    assert inv.on_hand("A") == 10
+    assert inv.reserved("A") == 2
+    assert inv.available("A") == 8
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("qty", [0, -1])
+def test_release_requires_positive_quantity(qty):
+    inv = Inventory()
+    inv.receive("A", 5)
+    inv.reserve("A", 3)
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        inv.release("A", qty)
+
+    assert inv.on_hand("A") == 5
+    assert inv.reserved("A") == 3
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("reserved,qty", [(3, 4), (0, 1)])
+def test_cannot_release_more_than_reserved(reserved, qty):
+    inv = Inventory()
+    inv.receive("A", 5)
+    if reserved:
+        inv.reserve("A", reserved)
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        inv.release("A", qty)
+
+    assert inv.on_hand("A") == 5
+    assert inv.reserved("A") == reserved
